12d51bcf8d.q: What is the CR4 ratio and why does it exceed 40% in most agricultural sectors?
12d51bcf8d.a: The CR4 is the combined market share of top producers in any given part of agribusiness. Most, if not all sectors of the agricultural economy are currently existing in a place where the CR4 exceeds 40% by a lot. This comes from decades of mergers and acquisitions that concentrate power within the ag sector, actively reducing market competition and allowing control over seeds, inputs, machinery, and equipment available to farmers.
12d51bcf8d.e: FYI: This is why your food is so expensive (Extractive Tapestry 6)
12d51bcf8d.rq: If you couple synthetic inputs and pesticides alone, just those two things alone, you're looking at dead soil within just a few years.
